real_correction.issue: Legacy §7 unqualified P = ET + runoff + recharge + change in storage can double-count recharge in a whole-catchment budget when groundwater storage/baseflow are also included.
real_correction.resolution: Explicitly separate catchment boundary budget (external inputs=external outputs+total storage change) from soil-zone budget where recharge can be an output.
